simple.meaning: בּוּר (bûwr) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to bore , i.e. (figuratively) examine.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Ecclesiastes, beginning at Ecclesiastes 9:1. The surrounding contexts include righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בּוּר (H952) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בּוּר (bûwr) / H952 is traced through Ecclesiastes 9:1 with source-language evidence and verse context.
